The consequence of black matriarchal culture is showing up in basketball. You see it in the NBA. You can see it clear as day in college hoops. The absence of fathers and patriarchal culture weakens EVERYTHING, including basketball.  

Purdue, Iowa, Iowa State, Illinois, Nebraska.

The matriarchy is not sustainable.

Maybe I'm not weird. Maybe I'm willing to discuss what's obvious. Maybe I'm just not scared.


Tom Maniscalco (@TSManiscalco)

You’re so weird, Jason



— https://nitter.net/TSManiscalco/status/2035893003827445851#m

Nebraska, Purdue, Iowa, Iowa State.... 

Exciting Whites have replaced Cinderella.

Peak delusion.


Rod Torfelson (@sbc0718)

What am I appreciating here, sir?



— https://nitter.net/sbc0718/status/2035887833949339846#m

Beyond killing Cinderella and CBS' DEI studio show, the story of this tournament is you're best served with 2 to 4 foundational, ain't-portaling, no-ponytail Exciting Whites in your 7-man rotation. Bill Self is one of my favorite coaches. Make sure he sees this tweet.

This is absolutely incredible!!  I had to watch it twice before I could truly appreciate it.

Video

Does No. 24 for Purdue look like a WNBA player?

I cannot get used to ponytails and manbuns. It's disconcerting.

Disagree. 

Texas has as much money to spend as any team. Not a Cinderella.


Sam Block (@theblockspot)

Texas is an 11-seed.
Texas went 9-9 in the SEC.
Texas played in the First Four.

School size means nothing.
Texas is absolutely a real Cinderella.



— https://nitter.net/theblockspot/status/2035525538010345839#m
Breaking: With Renee Montgomery out sick tomorrow,  CBS plans to showcase Jasmine Crockett for its NCAA studio show on Sunday, per sources.
Lakers are a fun story. Great win.

Let me admit it. 

I miss Bruce Pearl.  Seriously. I miss Bruce Pearl on the studio show.
That's a really hard slap on the MSU players' hand. Brutal.  Kholer may never recover from that stinging feeling. Reminds me of Jack Tatum and Daryl Stingley.

Look, I think what Indiana did is great. Best-coached team in college football. NIL and the transfer portal made it possible. Everything in college sports is a pay-for-play story at this point.


🌰Buckeye Sloopy (@419_sloopy)

Jason, who did they outspend? Miami, Bama, Oregon, Ohio State easily outspent them. 

How was it pay for play?



— https://nitter.net/419_sloopy/status/2035369174722044268#m
These coaches are clever pawning these interviews off on their players.

Is Taylor Sheridan the ChatGPT of TV shows?

One person cannot write every show on every network. Sheridan is a brand that's suppose to signal the show is slightly less woke than what you're used to.

True.


RP McMurphy (@WellOverTheNest)

You are just angry because Charles Barkley is losing weight at a higher rate than you



— https://nitter.net/WellOverTheNest/status/2035406129375645717#m

Good lord. 

CBS pushes out James Brown the same year NBC pushed out Tony Dungy. 

Wow. 

The secular agenda never stops.


Ryan Glasspiegel (@sportsrapport)

Have seen a few people asking why Nate Burleson is CBS March Madness studio host.

Ernie Johnson asked to step back from some of the dates in the role. 

CBS is testing to see if Burleson could eventually replace James Brown as NFL Today host.



— https://nitter.net/sportsrapport/status/2035408307825869138#m

Why is a former NFL player the host? She's terrible, but she's more qualified to be there than Nate Burleson.


FightTheGoodFight (@YouWontCancelMe)

What is the need to insert a WNBA player into the mix?   Has there been some huge outcry for a female studio voice during March Madness that I missed?  Bring back the old white male coaches...



— https://nitter.net/YouWontCancelMe/status/2035405491656860104#m

This CBS studio show is why I say capitalism is dead.  

Capitalism = the customer is always right. 

Equity = the agenda is always right.
